snippet.description:
After a tiring day at college or work, sitting down to study can feel difficult. In this short, AIR 170 Abhijeet Jain explains why we naturally reach for our phones instead of books and how this affects our study habits. He highlights two things aspirants need to work on: staying away from distractions and building a more rewarding study routine.
